comment: What the room scripts don't say, for tools/routesim/sim.py. Flags are [bank, flag] (bank 0/1 scenario, 2 locks,
7 room items; flag n = bit 31 - n % 32 of word n / 32). Each entry names its source: a labelled flag in
data/games/re1/flag-labels.json, the decomp (facts), a live trace, or the walkthrough (facts only).

jill.why: set by the time Jill enters the main hall in a new game (live flag log 2026-10-27, run 3); B[11] is the decomp's GameStart first-playthrough marker

chris.why: Chris's start flags aren't logged yet (B[0] alone, as in Jill's game, leaves him stuck at the crest door): to check with a flag log of a Chris new game

gates.why: behind the wall the piano opens (flag-labels B[165])
past the plant the herbicide kills (flag-labels B[169])

use.why: playing the piano opens the secret room (init reads B[165]; the event that sets it isn't decoded yet)

ways.why: across the pool: the crank drains it (flag-labels A[47]; walkthrough)
the lift down to the falls is across the pool (flag-labels A[48] is the lift)

the ladder between the pools: after the battery (A[50], 302 event 6) and while the pool is full (302 init blocks it while A[47] is set); walkthrough order: battery, crank back, lift, ladder. The falls' two levels and lifts aren't modelled.

the steps down the fountain are under water until both medals are in (305 main sets A[29] once A[27] and A[28] are)

examine.why: a Doom book opens to a medal (walkthrough; which book holds which isn't checked)

kills.why: Plant 42 defeated (flag-labels A[41]; decomp SCENARIO_FLAGS.md: set when Plant 42 dies)

spots.why: the lab computer's password screens (exe): log in, then B2's password, then open B3 (walkthrough); 508 main turns A[52..54] into the door events' sys[5..7]. Lock 37 (503's door to the visual data room 504, a 'locked' message until it's set; no script sets it) opens with them: the walkthrough goes there right after.
